scope: Independent old-development randomized packetization sensitivity study; not ImageNet100 paper replication
question: Measure the effect of fixed versus randomized token packet assignment while retaining existing model, metric, channel and class-condition identities; do not choose a new primary pipeline.
permutation_rule: For image i, PCG64 seed 202611260+i produces p. Packetizer receives tx[p] using existing reshape(1,4,64).transpose(0,2,1). Received IDs and expanded token masks are restored to original positions with inverse(p). The same image permutation is held across all five trials and all six SNRs.

unchanged_settings.physical_chain: existing Sionna 0.19.2 AWGN CRC11 convolutional [101,111] soft Viterbi 16-QAM
unchanged_settings.noise_coupling: same seed for each image/trial across SNRs; scaled-noise common-random-number design
unchanged_settings.mask: same sender-truth oracle packet mask for both generation paths
unchanged_settings.metric_conventions: same raw PSNR, clamped normalized LPIPS and clipped PIL CLIP as primary; separate development cohort
unchanged_settings.input_output: demo x in [0,1] to raw decoded y

framing: Keep original per-packet CRC/convolutional code and full-frame QAM mapping; do not combine interleaver changes with padding or retry changes.
audits_required: Exact permutation bijection and ID/mask inverse round trip
PHY source/seed/weight/packet identities and no-noise round trip
All 300 receptions and all four paths verified against sender IDs
Same oracle mask across class modes within each stream; fixed and random streams may have different error masks
Final token equality and unmasked-position preservation; ideal correct-token metric matches unchanged decode reference
Execution locks for new source scripts and input identities, excluding all existing frozen outputs
aggregation: Each SNR must have 50 complete receptions in both fixed and randomized streams. Average five trials within image, then ten images; retain all four paths and all per-image paired differences. Incomplete SNR groups report coverage only.
limits: Ten old Imagenette development images; not a new holdout or ImageNet100 evaluation
Random-position recipe is preregistered project implementation; exact paper permutation seed was not recovered
Perfect class label and sender-truth oracle masks; no CMI transmission cost
No physical retransmission or resource-equivalent Cheng baseline
